name: Kila Kushan
source:
A former Neo-Terra soldier, who used to go to a school made up of the children of the highest ranking Neo-Terran offices.
She is currently a lieutenant in the Kushan Army, the most powerful warlord on Mars, and the pilot of an armored aircraft.
An ace pilot that is the center of the Kushan Army.
Feared as the 'Grim Reaper of Sand' She has sunk countless battleships and is feared by many people.
The daughter of Beatrice, her father's identity is unknown.

Kira has the good looks of her mother, but her exotic brown skin was potentially influenced by her father.
Using her natural physical abilities, she is an expert in combat knife fighting.
She is also her mother's personal bodyguard.
